body: @deckar01 Try to pass `treeshake: false` option until we fix it.
@deckar01 There's no such flag in rollup cli. Specify this option in config please.

@TrySound I went ahead and repeated the 2 test cases from https://github.com/rollup/rollup/issues/932#issuecomment-246744860 using a config file, but the results were exactly the same.

The option for disabling tree shaking was add in #625 with tests for the command line, but it is for "debugging" purposes so it never got documented. Boolean CLI flags automatically get a corresponding `--no-*` counterpart (see the conflict, indent, and strict options).

> ## [:link: 0.26.1](https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/5b68b14052806364878975dc976eda1b7ea35cab/CHANGELOG.md#0261)
> - Add `treeshake: false`/`--no-treeshake` option for debugging (#505)

Should the corresponding CLI flag be added to the CLI wiki?

Either way, turning off tree shaking did not resolve the issue, so I will update the title to reflect that the bug might not be occurring in the tree shaking phase.

body: @blobor Is this issue present in `rollup-stream 1.13.0` (`rollup ^0.35.4`), but not `rollup-stream 1.12.0` (`rollup ^0.34.10`)?
@deckar01 I can confirm that, I downgraded rollup to `^0.34.0` yesterday because of this issue, and the problem disappeared.
Thanks @mairatma. That means the regression is somewhere in https://github.com/rollup/rollup/compare/7ad9f69...5d5eb24. Still a lot of ground to cover, but it's nice to have some leads to follow.
